category: managed metrics, logs and traces (time-series observability database)
tier: Free 30-day trial / paid capacity tiers (from $200/month Initial Tier)

free_tier.stated: A free 30-day trial grants $200 in credits to spend across VictoriaMetrics, VictoriaLogs and VictoriaTraces deployments; it starts when the first deployment is created. Ongoing paid tiers start from $200/month for the Initial Tier (500k active time series, 16.6k datapoints/sec, 170 GB daily read volume).
free_tier.notes: The only free allowance is the time-limited 30-day trial with $200 credits; there is no permanent free tier. Credits cover compute, storage and network; egress beyond them is metered.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no single-object cap is published; the Initial Tier capacities are 500k active time series, 16.6k datapoints/sec and 170 GB daily read volume, which are deployment limits rather than a per-object cap.

retention.stated: A deployment chooses a retention period; the price calculator offers 1, 6, 12 or 18 months. At trial expiry existing trial deployments are automatically deleted; after the trial ends, deployments are stopped and deleted after 7 days if no payment method is found.
retention.notes: days is null because retention is a user-selected tier setting, not a single fixed window; the 7-day post-trial deletion is a grace period, not a data-retention policy.

egress.terms: Egress traffic is charged $0.09 per GB, matching AWS' rate; estimated traffic costs typically range from $1 to $30 per month. Storage is $0.511 per Gb per month; backups are included at no extra cost and usage is metered hourly.

interface_detail: Prometheus remote-write and vmagent ingest; OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, InfluxDB, Datadog, New Relic, OpenTSDB and Graphite protocols; the deployment endpoint works as a Grafana data source. Programmatic access uses bearer tokens and console API keys; Terraform automation is supported.
tooling: Prometheus, vmagent, Grafana data source, OpenTelemetry collectors, curl/REST queries; self-hosted VictoriaMetrics open-source components are the last-resort option
chaining: A managed VictoriaMetrics endpoint drops in as a Prometheus remote-write target and Grafana data source; the open-source single-node or cluster binaries that the user installs and runs are the last resort when a hosted deployment is not used.

limits.value: Initial Tier: 500k active time series, 16.6k datapoints/sec, 170 GB daily read volume
30-day trial with $200 credits; after trial expiry deployments are stopped and deleted after 7 days if no payment method is added

binding_note: Each deployment has predefined capacity limits and alerts on spikes; the Initial Tier's active-series, ingestion-rate and daily-read-volume ceilings bind before any per-object cap, which is not published.

identity_cost.detail: Registration is via Google sign-in or email and password; adding a payment method is not required to register or use deployments during the 30-day trial, and the trial grants $200 in credits.

reliability_note: Usage is metered hourly and billed monthly; each deployment has predefined limits and sends alerts on spikes rather than charging overages. Trial deployments are deleted when credits expire; egress is charged $0.09 per GB.
confidence_note: Pricing, egress, trial and registration facts are from first-party VictoriaMetrics product, FAQ, billing and registration pages captured on 2026-11-19. No numeric per-object cap is published and is left unverified.
